title: Simultaneous detection and quantification of six equine cytokines in plasma using a fluorescent microsphere immunoassay (FMIA)
author: Hall, Stucke, et al.

steps.title: Collect and store horse plasma
steps.instruction: Collect blood from 40 healthy male horses by jugular venipuncture into EDTA Monovette® tubes (EDTA DE/9 ml, Sarstedt). Centrifuge immediately at 4 °C, 800 g for 15 min. Aliquot plasma into 1.5 ml Sarstedt microtubes and store at –80 °C. Ship frozen samples on dry ice to the analysis laboratory.

steps.title: Prepare assay buffer and microsphere plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the assay buffer consisting of 81 % distilled water, 10 % R&D Systems Reagent Diluent, and 9 % heat‑inactivated fetal calf serum (Gibco). Use magnetic, fluorescently labelled microspheres pre‑coupled with capture antibody at 20 µg ml⁻¹. Dispense 50 µl of these microspheres into each well of a 96‑well black flat‑bottom plate (BioRad 171‑025001). Wash the plate twice with BioRad wash buffer (171‑025001) using a Bio‑Plex Pro II wash station.

steps.title: Add standards and plasma samples
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl of prepared recombinant standards, diluted plasma samples, assay controls, or blanks (assay buffer only) to the corresponding wells.

steps.title: Incubate samples with microspheres
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate in the dark with shaking at 700 rpm at room temperature for 110 min.

steps.title: Add detection antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the plate three times as before. Add 100 µl of detection antibody diluted in assay buffer to each well. Incubate in the dark with shaking at 700 rpm at room temperature for 50 min.

steps.title: Add Streptavidin‑PE (SAPE)
steps.instruction: Wash the plate three times as before. Add 50 µl of 1× Streptavidin‑phycoerythrin (SAPE, BioRad) to each well. Incubate in the dark with shaking at 700 rpm at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Final wash and assay buffer addition
steps.instruction: Wash the plate three times as before. Add 125 µl of assay buffer to each well and incubate with shaking at 700 rpm for 5 min.

steps.title: Acquire data on Bio‑Plex
steps.instruction: Read the plate on a Bio‑Plex 200® instrument and analyse the data with Bio‑Plex Manager software version 6.1. Record the mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) for 100 microspheres per cytokine, background‑correct (F‑Fo) using blank values, and generate a 5‑parameter logistic (5PL) standard curve; acceptable recovery is 70–130 %.
